answer: Each identity must join a small mutual-insurance ring of five strangers, posting a bond the ring can claim if any member is proven fake. Rings reshuffle every epoch, so a farm's clones cannot hide together: like a voyage through unfamiliar ports, each clone lands beside honest strangers paid to report it. To forge a thousand identities means posting one thousand bonds, and one proven link lets the ring seize the whole cluster's stake. A yarrow of small honest rings prices duplication out: one real agent risks one bond, a Sybil operator risks a thousand against strangers paid to catch it.
